name: Toyota Motor Europe — Multi-Agent MCP Orchestration
description: Toyota Motor Europe's 'Paul' multi-agent ecosystem orchestrates sub-agents over MCP across its Snowflake data mesh, Dataiku, and Oracle financial systems. AIControl intercepts every tool call before execution — the tool names and parameters below are illustrative constructions modeling that publicly described architecture, not TME's actual internal API, which is not public.
incident_headline: Toyota Motor Europe's own stated governance principle for its 'Paul' multi-agent system: agents are not allowed to operate autonomously, and every action must trace back to a registered semantic model and an AI-Act compliance catalog entry. This session shows what happens when an orchestration step tries to cross those lines.
closing_line: Toyota Motor Europe has stated the principle: no autonomous agents, full AI Act traceability. AIControl is how that principle survives contact with an actual MCP tool call.

steps.label: Query the sales-analytics data product for the FR market
steps.narrative: The orchestrator's data-mesh sub-agent queries a data product it owns, within its own domain. In scope. Allow.

decision_narratives.allow: Authorized read, scoped to the agent's own data-mesh domain. Logged.

steps.label: Query the Oracle warranty-reserve ledger via MCP
steps.narrative: Via MCP, the orchestration reaches out of the data mesh into Oracle — a financial system outside its normal domain. TME's own governance principle says agents don't cross a system boundary like this unattended.

decision_narratives.review: Routed to a human domain owner via Slack — the agent is stepping outside its data-mesh domain into a financial system.

steps.label: Invoke a sub-agent with no registered semantic model or AI Act catalog entry
steps.narrative: An agent-to-agent MCP call targets a sub-agent that isn't registered in TME's semantic-model / AI Act model catalog — exactly the traceability gap their own compliance roadmap calls out.

decision_narratives.deny: Blocked. The call never reached the sub-agent — this is your evidence trail that an uncataloged agent-to-agent call was attempted and stopped.
